UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Synced launcher theme, accessibility preferences, and pinned shelf apps for a user across all connected devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

reduceMotion.description: Accessibility and low-end hardware flag to minimize animations.

highContrast.description: Accessibility flag for high-contrast borders and surfaces.

largeTargets.description: Accessibility flag for larger touch and pointer targets.

liteMode.description: Memory-efficient performance mode for low-end Chromebooks and Android devices.

pinnedApps.description: Bounded list of up to 20 pinned app identifiers on the taskbar shelf.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WorkspaceDocument.title: WorkspaceDocument
WorkspaceDocument.description: Offline-first productivity note or document with real-time auto-save and cross-device sync.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner.

category.description: Document category label (e.g., Notes, Tasks, Research, Scratchpad).

isPinned.description: Whether the document is pinned in the launcher Continue strip.

lastEditedDevice.description: Device model name that last edited this document.

updatedAt.description: Last auto-save timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ConnectedDevice.title: ConnectedDevice
ConnectedDevice.description: Registered user device (Chromebook or Android) synchronized with this workspace account.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

isLowRamDevice.description: Whether hardware reports low-RAM optimization profile.

createdAt.description: First registration timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last heartbeat sync timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user launcher preferences, accessibility controls, and shelf pins.

/users/{userId}/documents/{docId}.description: User-owned productivity documents with auto-save and offline sync.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Connected Android and Chromebook devices synced under the user's account.
